label: The re-embed path is faithful: the unchanged /doctor:install text reproduces its stored vector at cosine 1.000000, every updated row is 3072 bytes with model nomic-embed-text-v1.5 and a matching content hash, all 14 skill vectors are byte-identical, and exactly five command vectors changed.

With enriched vectors the capture reads plain tune top-1 18 of 45 (was 13), combined tune reach 33 of 45 (was 28), holdout top-1 5 of 44 (was 3), false offers 0 of 35, typed recall 24 of 44 and needs_mode_floor 1 of 35, all unchanged except the plain gains.
The five tune rows that moved are exactly the five scored commands and each now carries its own command at top-1; no other published tune row changed.
The holdout gain is two rows, from /doctor:install and /doctor:speckit each moving 0 of 1 to 1 of 1; the other three stayed 0 of 1, and only counts were read.
The three doctor-family floor rows at 0.82 still pass and still offer nothing: all keep system-skilled-doctor as the top and remain inside the unchanged false-offer total of 0 of 35.

/create:skill-parent cannot move from embedding text: it has no TypeScript bridge, no stored vector and no capture row, so its plain row stays empty despite the scratch text growing from 187 to 369 characters.

The measured gain is the vector half only: the capture still reads the tracked bridge projection for lexical evidence, so the build's lexical addition is not in these numbers; the scratch re-embed of five vectors plus two parity calls took 0.15 s wall with the model warm.

reason: There is no vec_cmd_768 row and no TypeScript id, so the update would write a vector nothing reads.
